prompt: Which best represents a simple binary chromosome mutation (flip one bit)?
explanation: Randomly pick one position (rng.nextInt(length)) and flip the bit: 0→1 or 1→0 using (1 - bit). Option A always sets position 0 to 1 (not random). Option C zeroes all genes (destroys the individual). Option D resets to default values (all 0s), losing all information.
